description.value: Cassavir is a negotiation before she is a fight. In her exchange, the Director can place any Reach Streets or Corp & Security minions or platoons as her people, already in position when trouble starts.
Cassavir sells introductions, not people. Anyone who crosses her isn’t killed — they are cut off: no fixer in the Flats brokers their work until the debt is settled.

Improved Cyberdeck under a grandmother-board skin. Cassavir gains +1 to her Intrusion Roll Modifier and +1 Integrity Damage Bonus at every result band. Extra program slots as the Director needs for her suite. This is class-tier, not the deck SKU — it persists if she swaps hardware.

Her deck runs a full suite. Use the Matrix pack programs if you need the items; names and table use:

  • Sneak — stay undetected while intruding; soften Alert ticks.
  • Reader — edge on Scan/Search; read Rating, ICE, paydata at a glance.
  • Mirror — spoof a device or user credential on the network.
  • Scrubber — amplify Ghost-the-Log / Alert-scrub.
  • Guardian — edge vs hostile ICE and enemy deckers; warn the crew when Alert spikes.
  • Overlord — hold one extra compromised node; issue a held-node command as a maneuver.

Cassavir’s Body Integrity is high. Soft chrome (Cyber-Eyes, Vocal Modulator, Empathy Processor) sells the grandmother look. Underneath: Datajack, Skillwires, light Dermal Plating, and an Implant Weapon. A good cosmetician did the work — do not play her as obviously chromed unless someone cuts her open.

NPC exception: her chrome is already in. Ignore hero-sheet “Cyborgs can’t install chrome” and the visible-plating tell; the grandmother look is the point.

target.custom: 1 Track 1 node within distance, or enemies her people can see

tier1.display: Seize a Track 1 node briefly (Trace Alert rises), or one ally within distance uses a signature ability against a marked enemy.

tier2.display: Seize the Track 1 node, or two allies within distance use a signature ability against the same marked target.

tier3.display: Seize the Track 1 node cleanly (no trace) and two allies within distance use a signature ability against the same marked target.

system.story: One pulse through the switchboard — a node flips, or her people already have the shot.

before0000000000.description:
Distance: Ranged 10 (Wire Reach in Overlay).

Choose: seize 1 Track 1 node within distance, or mark so her crew uses signatures. Add her Switchboard Deck’s Intrusion Roll Modifier on the seize path.

spend00000000000.description: The board does both: she seizes a Track 1 node within distance and two allies within distance can use a signature ability against the same target.

target.custom: 1 Track 1 object or item within Reach (including a person’s Wired-connected gear)

system.story: Chrome pops from the sleeve — an implant holdout, plus a stim for whoever is still standing.

spend00000000000.description: Cassavir tosses a stim from the kit. One ally adjacent to the target regains 7 Stamina.

system.story: The board already knows where they stepped.
system.trigger: An enemy within distance willingly moves.

after00000000000.description: At any point during the movement, Cassavir and one Wire-aware ally within distance can each make a free strike against the target. Her people hear the board; they already have the angle.
